baseline_metrics.ffmx_baseline_method: Empirical measurement across 2026-04-21 to 2026-04-28 sessions (4-lane parallel investigation)
baseline_metrics.success_threshold_description: FFMx_post / FFMx_pre >= 1.5 (50% improvement) required for mutation promotion

artifacts_count.measurement_method: Count of unique task_ids with investigation_label match in forensics/manifests/ directory
artifacts_count.notes: Average across 7 days of faerie2 production sessions

quality_average.measurement_method: Arithmetic mean of quality_score field across all manifests; fallback to belief_index if missing
quality_average.notes: High variance in early experiments due to inconsistent reporting; stabilizes around 0.88 in mature sessions

emergence_depth.measurement_method: Maximum path length in parent_task DAG; DFS from roots to leaves
emergence_depth.notes: 2.8 average indicates typical deep-and-wide monkeybranching; depth 1 = no spawning (vanilla); depth 5+ = rare but observed in 4-lane synthesis phases

tokens_burned.measurement_method: Sum of artifact_size_bytes × 0.125 (tokens/byte); fallback to 30.8K tokens/manifest × artifact_count
tokens_burned.notes: Wide variance due to wave strategy (W1 heavy = high burn; W3 light = low burn) and agent model selection (haiku cheap, sonnet expensive)

quality_times_emergence.interpretation: Product of confidence signal (Q) and depth amplification (E^1.5); measures signal propagation fidelity

measurement_confidence.notes: Emergence depth and token estimation have lower confidence due to sparse artifact_size_bytes data and heuristic tokens-per-byte calibration. These are recommendations for W2 refinement.

mutation_gate.implementation_phase: W2 CRUISE (7x_ffmx_calculator.py wired into session lifecycle)
mutation_gate.gate_rule: If FFMx_T+1 / FFMx_T0 >= 1.5, promote to standard measurement. Otherwise, continue tuning.
prescan_checks: Parent-child manifest links fully populated (parent_task field required for emergence calculation)
Quality_score fields must be present in >= 80% of manifests
Artifact_size_bytes must be populated for >= 50% of manifests (else fallback to heuristic)
Investigation_label used consistently across all manifests in sprint window

emergence_power_exponent.rationale: Empirical observation: depth 2 contributes ~3× amplification; depth 3 contributes ~5× amplification. Power law 1.5 fits (2^1.5=2.83, 3^1.5=5.20). Conservative; may adjust to 1.3–1.7 post-measurement.
emergence_power_exponent.validation_needed: Measure actual agent capability growth per depth; validate exponent post-W2 implementation

tokens_per_byte_heuristic.rationale: Text ≈ 0.1 tokens/byte; code ≈ 0.15. Average 0.125 is conservative middle.
tokens_per_byte_heuristic.validation_needed: Cross-check against 9x_token_ledger.py real measurements in W2

default_tokens_per_manifest.confidence: High for agent-driven work; lower for synthesizer (can burn 50K+)
default_tokens_per_manifest.validation_needed: Stratify by agent_type (ai-engineer vs knowledge-synthesizer) in post-W2 analysis
